# Vendored third-party code

## readability.js

Mozilla Readability, v0.5.0, unmodified.
Source: https://github.com/mozilla/readability
Licence: Apache License 2.0 — see ./LICENSE

Vendored as a file rather than taken as an npm dependency so the shipped
extension has no node_modules and no build step. Update by re-downloading
the released file; do not patch it locally.
